scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && npm run build --workspace @openapi-flow/core && npm run build --workspace @openapi-flow/langchain && npm run build --workspace @openapi-flow/n8n && npm run build --workspace @openapi-flow/example-langgraph-workflow && tsc -p examples/legacy-generation/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages/*/src test integration examples/*/src examples/langgraph-workflow/{package.json,tsconfig.json,README.md,specs} package.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write packages/*/src test integration examples/*/src examples/langgraph-workflow/{package.json,tsconfig.json,README.md,specs} package.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/legacy/*.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs
